Overview

Zurich is a city in Zurich with a population of 415,000. Switzerland’s largest city, a global financial hub on Lake Zurich with a stunning old town, vibrant cultural scene, and top-ranked quality of life. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
